verses.original: ט֥וֹב שֵׁ֖ם מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן ט֑וֹב וְי֣וֹם הַמָּ֔וֶת מִיּ֖וֹם הִוָּלְדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ šêm miš·še·men ṭō·wḇ wə·yō·wm ham·mā·weṯ mî·yō·wm hiw·wā·lə·ḏōw
verses.literal: A good name is better than fine perfume and one’s day of death is better than his day of birth

verses.original: ט֞וֹב לָלֶ֣כֶת אֶל־ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֗בֶל מִלֶּ֙כֶת֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בַּאֲשֶׁ֕ר ה֖וּא ס֣וֹף כָּל־ הָאָדָ֑ם וְהַחַ֖י יִתֵּ֥ן אֶל־ לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- bêṯ- ’ê·ḇel mil·le·ḵeṯ ’el- bêṯ miš·teh ba·’ă·šer hū sō·wp̄ kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām wə·ha·ḥay yit·tên ’el- lib·bōw
verses.literal: It is better to enter . . . a house of mourning than a house of feasting since death is the end of every man and the living should take this to heart

verses.original: ט֥וֹב כַּ֖עַס מִשְּׂחֹ֑ק כִּֽי־ בְרֹ֥עַ פָּנִ֖ים יִ֥יטַב לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ka·‘as miś·śə·ḥōq kî- ḇə·rō·a‘ pā·nîm yî·ṭaḇ lêḇ
verses.literal: Sorrow is better than laughter for a sad countenance is good for the heart

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חֲכָמִים֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֵ֔בֶל וְלֵ֥ב כְּסִילִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית שִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥă·ḵā·mîm bə·ḇêṯ ’ê·ḇel wə·lêḇ kə·sî·lîm bə·ḇêṯ śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure

verses.original: ט֕וֹב לִשְׁמֹ֖עַ גַּעֲרַ֣ת חָכָ֑ם מֵאִ֕ישׁ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ שִׁ֥יר כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ liš·mō·a‘ ga·‘ă·raṯ ḥā·ḵām mê·’îš šō·mê·a‘ šîr kə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: It is better to heed a wise man’s rebuke than to listen to the song of fools

verses.original: כִּ֣י כְק֤וֹל הַסִּירִים֙ תַּ֣חַת הַסִּ֔יר כֵּ֖ן שְׂחֹ֣ק הַכְּסִ֑יל וְגַם־ זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵə·qō·wl has·sî·rîm ta·ḥaṯ has·sîr kên śə·ḥōq hak·kə·sîl wə·ḡam- zeh hā·ḇel
verses.literal: For like the crackling of thorns under the pot so is the laughter of the fool This too is futile

verses.original: כִּ֥י הָעֹ֖שֶׁק יְהוֹלֵ֣ל חָכָ֑ם וִֽיאַבֵּ֥ד אֶת־ לֵ֖ב מַתָּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî hā·‘ō·šeq yə·hō·w·lêl ḥā·ḵām wî·’ab·bêḏ ’eṯ- lêḇ mat·tā·nāh
verses.literal: Surely extortion turns a wise man into a fool and a bribe corrupts the heart

verses.original: ט֛וֹב אַחֲרִ֥ית דָּבָ֖ר מֵֽרֵאשִׁית֑וֹ ט֥וֹב אֶֽרֶךְ־ ר֖וּחַ מִגְּבַהּ־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ’a·ḥă·rîṯ dā·ḇār mê·rê·šî·ṯōw ṭō·wḇ ’e·reḵ- rū·aḥ mig·gə·ḇah- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: The end of a matter is better than the beginning and a patient spirit is better than a proud one

verses.original: אַל־ תְּבַהֵ֥ל בְּרֽוּחֲךָ֖ לִכְע֑וֹס כִּ֣י כַ֔עַס בְּחֵ֥יק כְּסִילִ֖ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·ḇa·hêl bə·rū·ḥă·ḵā liḵ·‘ō·ws kî ḵa·‘as bə·ḥêq kə·sî·lîm yā·nū·aḥ
verses.literal: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit for anger settles in the lap of a fool

verses.original: אַל־ תֹּאמַר֙ מֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה שֶׁ֤הַיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים הָי֥וּ טוֹבִ֖ים מֵאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א מֵחָכְמָ֖ה שָׁאַ֥לְתָּ עַל־ זֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·mar meh hā·yāh še·hay·yā·mîm hā·ri·šō·nîm hā·yū ṭō·w·ḇîm mê·’êl·leh kî lō mê·ḥā·ḵə·māh šā·’al·tā ‘al- zeh
verses.literal: Do not say Why were the old . . . days better than these For it is unwise of you to ask about this

verses.original: טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה עִֽם־ נַחֲלָ֑ה וְיֹתֵ֖ר לְרֹאֵ֥י הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·w·ḇāh ḥāḵ·māh ‘im- na·ḥă·lāh wə·yō·ṯêr lə·rō·’ê haš·šā·meš
verses.literal: Wisdom like an inheritance is good and it benefits those who see the sun

verses.original: כִּ֛י בְּצֵ֥ל הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה בְּצֵ֣ל הַכָּ֑סֶף וְיִתְר֣וֹן דַּ֔עַת הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ṣêl ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh bə·ṣêl hak·kā·sep̄ wə·yiṯ·rō·wn da·‘aṯ ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh tə·ḥay·yeh ḇə·‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: For wisdom like money is a shelter and the advantage of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of its owner

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה אֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לְתַקֵּ֔ן אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִוְּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śêh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî mî yū·ḵal lə·ṯaq·qên ’êṯ ’ă·šer ‘iw·wə·ṯōw
verses.literal: Consider the work of God Who can straighten what He has bent

verses.original: בְּי֤וֹם טוֹבָה֙ הֱיֵ֣ה בְט֔וֹב וּבְי֥וֹם רָעָ֖ה רְאֵ֑ה גַּ֣ם אֶת־ זֶ֤ה לְעֻמַּת־ זֶה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־ דִּבְרַ֗ת שֶׁלֹּ֨א יִמְצָ֧א הָֽאָדָ֛ם אַחֲרָ֖יו מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ṭō·w·ḇāh hĕ·yêh ḇə·ṭō·wḇ ū·ḇə·yō·wm rā·‘āh rə·’êh gam ’eṯ- zeh lə·‘um·maṯ- zeh ‘ā·śāh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- diḇ·raṯ šel·lō yim·ṣā hā·’ā·ḏām ’a·ḥă·rāw mə·’ū·māh
verses.literal: In the day of prosperity be joyful but in the day of adversity consider this . . . God has made one of these along with the other so that . . . a man cannot discover anything that will come after him

verses.original: אֶת־ הַכֹּ֥ל רָאִ֖יתִי בִּימֵ֣י הֶבְלִ֑י יֵ֤שׁ צַדִּיק֙ אֹבֵ֣ד בְּצִדְק֔וֹ וְיֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֔ע מַאֲרִ֖יךְ בְּרָעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hak·kōl rā·’î·ṯî bî·mê heḇ·lî yêš ṣad·dîq ’ō·ḇêḏ bə·ṣiḏ·qōw wə·yêš rā·šā‘ ma·’ă·rîḵ bə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: In my futile life I have seen both of these A righteous man perishing in his righteousness and a wicked man living long in his wickedness

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֤י צַדִּיק֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה וְאַל־ תִּתְחַכַּ֖ם יוֹתֵ֑ר לָ֖מָּה תִּשּׁוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ṣad·dîq har·bêh wə·’al- tiṯ·ḥak·kam yō·w·ṯêr lām·māh tiš·šō·w·mêm
verses.literal: Do not be overly righteous and do not make yourself too wise Why should you destroy yourself?

verses.original: אַל־ תִּרְשַׁ֥ע הַרְבֵּ֖ה וְאַל־ תְּהִ֣י סָכָ֑ל לָ֥מָּה תָמ֖וּת בְּלֹ֥א עִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tir·ša‘ har·bêh wə·’al- tə·hî sā·ḵāl lām·māh ṯā·mūṯ bə·lō ‘it·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not be excessively wicked and do not be a fool Why should you die before your time

verses.original: ט֚וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֶּאֱחֹ֣ז בָּזֶ֔ה וְגַם־ מִזֶּ֖ה אַל־ תַּנַּ֣ח אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֵצֵ֥א אֶת־ כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ ’ă·šer te·’ĕ·ḥōz bā·zeh wə·ḡam- miz·zeh ’al- tan·naḥ ’eṯ- yā·ḏe·ḵā kî- yə·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm yê·ṣê ’eṯ- kul·lām
verses.literal: It is good to grasp the one and not let the other slip from your hand For he who fears God will follow both warnings

verses.original: הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תָּעֹ֣ז לֶחָכָ֑ם מֵֽעֲשָׂרָה֙ שַׁלִּיטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh tā·‘ōz le·ḥā·ḵām mê·‘ă·śā·rāh šal·lî·ṭîm ’ă·šer hā·yū bā·‘îr
verses.literal: Wisdom makes the wise man stronger than ten rulers - in a city

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָדָ֔ם אֵ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂה־ טּ֖וֹב וְלֹ֥א יֶחֱטָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·ḏām ’ên ṣad·dîq bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh- ṭō·wḇ wə·lō ye·ḥĕ·ṭā
verses.literal: Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins

verses.original: גַּ֤ם לְכָל־ הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אַל־ תִּתֵּ֖ן לִבֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ תִשְׁמַ֥ע אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֖ מְקַלְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: gam lə·ḵāl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bê·rū ’al- tit·tên lib·be·ḵā ’ă·šer lō- ṯiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā mə·qal·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not pay attention to every word that is spoken or you may hear your servant cursing you

verses.original: כִּ֛י גַּם־ פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת יָדַ֣ע לִבֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גַּם־ אַתְּ קִלַּ֥לְתָּ אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî gam- pə·‘ā·mîm rab·bō·wṯ yā·ḏa‘ lib·be·ḵā ’ă·šer gam- ʾat qil·lal·tā ’ă·ḥê·rîm
verses.literal: For . . . you know in your heart that . . . many times you yourself have cursed others

verses.original: כָּל־ זֹ֖ה נִסִּ֣יתִי בַֽחָכְמָ֑ה אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֶחְכָּ֔מָה וְהִ֖יא רְחוֹקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zōh nis·sî·ṯî ḇa·ḥā·ḵə·māh ’ā·mar·tî ’eḥ·kā·māh wə·hî rə·ḥō·w·qāh mim·men·nî
verses.literal: All this I tested by wisdom, saying I resolve to be wise But it was beyond me

verses.original: רָח֖וֹק מַה־ שֶּׁהָיָ֑ה וְעָמֹ֥ק׀ עָמֹ֖ק מִ֥י יִמְצָאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ḥō·wq mah- še·hā·yāh wə·‘ā·mōq ‘ā·mōq mî yim·ṣā·’en·nū
verses.literal: What exists is out of reach and very deep . . . Who can fathom it

verses.original: סַבּ֨וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֤י וְלִבִּי֙ לָדַ֣עַת וְלָת֔וּר וּבַקֵּ֥שׁ חָכְמָ֖ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְלָדַ֙עַת֙ רֶ֣שַׁע כֶּ֔סֶל וְהַסִּכְל֖וּת הוֹלֵלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: sab·bō·w·ṯî ’ă·nî wə·lib·bî lā·ḏa·‘aṯ wə·lā·ṯūr ū·ḇaq·qêš ḥāḵ·māh wə·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·lā·ḏa·‘aṯ re·ša‘ ke·sel wə·has·siḵ·lūṯ hō·w·lê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: I directed my mind to understand to explore to search out wisdom and explanations and to understand the stupidity of wickedness and the folly of madness

verses.original: וּמוֹצֶ֨א אֲנִ֜י מַ֣ר מִמָּ֗וֶת אֶת־ הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֨יא מְצוֹדִ֧ים וַחֲרָמִ֛ים לִבָּ֖הּ אֲסוּרִ֣ים יָדֶ֑יהָ ט֞וֹב לִפְנֵ֤י הָאֱלֹהִים֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְחוֹטֵ֖א יִלָּ֥כֶד בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·ṣe ’ă·nî mar mim·mā·weṯ ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- hî mə·ṣō·w·ḏîm wa·ḥă·rā·mîm lib·bāh ’ă·sū·rîm yā·ḏe·hā ṭō·wḇ lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yim·mā·lêṭ mim·men·nāh wə·ḥō·w·ṭê yil·lā·ḵeḏ bāh
verses.literal: And I find more bitter than death the woman who . . . is a snare whose heart is a net and whose hands are chains The man who pleases . . . God escapes her but the sinner is ensnared

verses.original: רְאֵה֙ זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אָמְרָ֖ה קֹהֶ֑לֶת אַחַ֥ת לְאַחַ֖ת לִמְצֹ֥א חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh zeh mā·ṣā·ṯî ’ā·mə·rāh qō·he·leṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·’a·ḥaṯ lim·ṣō ḥeš·bō·wn
verses.literal: Behold says the Teacher I have discovered this by adding one thing to another to find an explanation

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֛ר עוֹד־ בִּקְשָׁ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑אתִי אָדָ֞ם אֶחָ֤ד מֵאֶ֙לֶף֙ מָצָ֔אתִי וְאִשָּׁ֥ה בְכָל־ אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ‘ō·wḏ- biq·šāh nap̄·šî wə·lō mā·ṣā·ṯî ’ā·ḏām ’e·ḥāḏ mê·’e·lep̄ mā·ṣā·ṯî wə·’iš·šāh ḇə·ḵāl- ’êl·leh lō mā·ṣā·ṯî
verses.literal: While my soul was still searching but not finding among a thousand I have found one upright man but among all these I have not found one such woman

verses.original: לְבַד֙ רְאֵה־ זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָאָדָ֖ם יָשָׁ֑ר וְהֵ֥מָּה בִקְשׁ֖וּ חִשְּׁבֹנ֥וֹת רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇaḏ rə·’êh- zeh mā·ṣā·ṯî ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām yā·šār wə·hêm·māh ḇiq·šū ḥiš·šə·ḇō·nō·wṯ rab·bîm
verses.literal: Only this have I found I have discovered that God made mankind upright but they have sought out many schemes
